body:
Track 4 (`robofab`), follow-up to `robofab-armaccel` / `robofab-graspmove`. MuJoCo check of the friction-grasp bound beyond the 40 m/s² it had been tested to.

- Fine contact settings (dt 0.05 ms, solref 0.1 ms): simulated minimum force is 0.89–1.02× the bound over 39 cases up to 800 m/s² (median 1.00).
- The earlier settings give no result at 400/800 m/s² (12 of 39): a contact-lag artefact, shown by a settings sweep.
- Stylised: prescribed constant acceleration, rigid box pads, no arm dynamics.

Tests: 6 pass; `python site/build.py` prints ok. README, white paper, site entry and README bullet included.
